newsitem.title: USA: Insurance Group says SEC probe not tied to abuses.
newsitem.headline: Insurance Group says SEC probe not tied to abuses.

text.p: The American Council of Life Insurance said on Friday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission inquiry into the marketing of variable annuities is not based on evidence of widespread abuses.
The council, a trade association, said it was responding to what it described as exaggerated news accounts earlier this week about the SEC move.

The council said the SEC, in its letter to a group of life insurance companies, said the request for documents and information "should not be construed ... as an indication by the commissionor its staff that any violation of law has occurred."
